<p><strong>Thursday 15 October 2026, 18:30-21:00</strong><br><strong>Sloane Robinson Building, Temple Quarter Enterprise Campus</strong></p>
<p>Join researchers and industry experts for an evening exploring the latest developments in flexible electronics and their applications in healthcare. Speakers include representatives from the University of Bristol, Imperial College London, University of West London and the Centre for Process Innovation (CPI). The event is advertised as being open to both IEEE members and non-members.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.ieee-ukandireland.org/event/ieee-uk-and-ireland-section-public-event-flexible-electronics-in-healthcare/"><strong>Further information about the event.</strong></a></p>
<p><em>Please note: Registration via the organisers may now have closed. Anyone interested in attending is encouraged to contact the event organiser (<a href="mailto:faezeh.arabhassani@bristol.ac.uk">faezeh.arabhassani@bristol.ac.uk</a>) to enquire about availability before travelling.</em></p>
</div><br><br><b><div>World Mental Health Day</div></b><br><div>
<p><strong>10 October 2026 - World Mental Health Day<br>Lived Experiences Heard: Real Voices, Real Change</strong></p>
<p>At the University of Bristol, we recognise that mental health is just as important as physical health.</p>
<p>This <a href="https://wmhdofficial.com/">World Mental Health Day</a>, let's take time to check in with ourselves, support one another, and continue building a culture where everyone feels able to talk openly about mental wellbeing. Together, we can create a healthier, kinder and more supportive university community for students and staff alike. &nbsp;</p>
<p>Remember, <a href="https://www.bristol.ac.uk/study/postgraduate/student-life/wellbeing/">support is available</a>, and seeking help is a sign of strength.</p>
